title: Require exact product identity for market verification
guarantees: Marketplace evidence cannot verify a sale until the listing's product series matches an accepted alias for the target BreakMetric product.
Topps Premier League and Topps Chrome Premier League are treated as distinct product families.
Listing card number, parallel, print run and player must match the market record before original-marketplace verification can pass.
Evidence templates keep observed listing identity blank so the operator must explicitly confirm it from the marketplace source.
Verified market records are re-audited for stored product identity during CI.
A visually similar card with the same player and serial copy cannot cross-verify another product series.
